name: gitlab-official-docs
instructions: The official documentation of GitLab CI/CD, kept locally: the folder doc/ci of the GitLab documentation (.gitlab-ci.yml and the reference of every keyword), GitLab Runner and the Dev Containers CLI. Search with search_docs, then read one section with read_doc. Look it up rather than guess it.
search: Search the official documentation of GitLab CI/CD: .gitlab-ci.yml and its keywords, variables, cache, artifacts, rules, pipelines, GitLab Runner and its executors, the Dev Containers CLI. Returns 10 section ids at most.
